subject: maths
question: The height of a cylinder is 45 cm. If circumference of its base is 132 cm, then what is the curved surface of this cylinder ? (use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = Base Circumference × Height

Given Circumference = 132 cm and Height = 45 cm

CSA = 132 × 45

CSA = 132 × (50 − 5) = 6600 − 660 = 5940 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 5940 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height (h) = 45 cm

Circumference of base (2πr) = 132 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16d1e6ab67c082221de5b1b402ecbe6fd456eddce8286635fd7df31477e3a541.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base Circumference = 2 × π × r = 132 cm

⇒ Curved Surface Area = (2 × π × r) × h

⇒ CSA = 132 × 45

⇒ CSA = 5940 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 5940 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

TSA includes the curved surface and the areas of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of Cylinder

The space occupied by the cylinder is given by Volume = Base Area × Height = πr²h.

Base Radius Calculation

If required, the radius (r) can be found from circumference: r = Circumference ÷ 2π. For 132 cm, r = (132 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22) = 21 cm.</p
